quest.title: Priorities First
quest.description: The Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau clearly has many more secrets...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This isn't what we're looking for...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... looks like this door won't open. Paimon's really curious about what's on the other side...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Considering where it is, this doesn't seem like the kind of place where anything important would be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now we've really gotta take a look inside! Otherwise, it'll sit in Paimon's head like having a belly full of Nod-Krai Hot Dogs that just won't go down!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The door might be locked, but maybe there's another way in.

choices.text: There must be an evil experiment going on inside...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: E—Evil experiment... If that's the case, the security here is way too lax!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like some sort of research records?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Jar
dialogues.text: (I wonder what's inside...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many jars! And inside them... could it be kuuvahki?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are the Fatui doing, placing these things so deep underground?

choices.text: So they can use them, of course...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Obviously, Paimon knows that! But what are they using them for? Presumably, it's not for bathing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's investigate around here first. Maybe we'll uncover some clues.

choices.text: It must be some kind of evil experiment!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we all know the Fatui are pretty evil! But Paimon wants to know the details!

talks.objective: Look for clues in the area

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: (test) Readable Placeholder - Research Log

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... This doesn't seem very useful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like they really were doing experiments here, but this isn't the only place. There are three more sites up on the surface.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #They're collecting data from those sites and then sending it down here for analysis. Hey, {NICKNAME}, what if we made off with all their data?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, actually, Paimon's kinda curious about what they found out. How about... how about we collect the data from all three sites, check the results, and then take everything with us!?

choices.text: Why do we need to take the results?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Duh! So the Fatui don't get their hands on them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Besides, aren't you the least bit curious about the results, {NICKNAME}? Come on, let's give it a try!

choices.text: Feels like it'd be simpler to just destroy everything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That'd cause way too much of a scene, wouldn't it? Let's not go overboard here and create a bunch of needless noise...

talks.objective: Go to the marked location to retrieve data
Go to the marked location to retrieve data

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like they really were doing experiments here, but this isn't the only place. There are three more sites up on the surface.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait a minute, was that stuff we picked up earlier the data the Fatui were trying to retrieve?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about... how about we input all the data, check the results, and then take everything with us?

choices.text: Why do we need to take the results?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Duh! So the Fatui don't get their hands on them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Besides, aren't you the least bit curious about the results, {NICKNAME}? Come on, let's give it a try!

choices.text: Feels like it'd be simpler to just destroy everything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That'd cause way too much of a scene, wouldn't it? Let's not go overboard here and create a bunch of needless noise...

talks.objective: Go to the marked location to retrieve data

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're locked in! This has to be another trap. How are we supposed to get out...?

dialogues.speaker: Kholodov
dialogues.text: The device has been activated? Does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Kholodov
dialogues.text: Let's see which filthy rat has snuck in this time... You!? You're the criminals who ruined the experiment site! And now you dare come here!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon doesn't feel like a beating right now! Quick, do something about that barrier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We finally got rid of them — huh? Why isn't the machine showing anything? Don't tell me it got broken during the fight... Or did the Fatui shut it down?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, all that and we still didn't get to see the results...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}, did you hear that strange sound just now? P—Paimon thinks it came from that way...

talks.objective: Investigate the source of the unusual sound

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Wow! Is that a white Weasel Thief? Paimon's never seen one that white before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Paimon's Mora! Stop right there, you thief!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Unable to catch up, you watch helplessly as the white Weasel Thief runs away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, it zipped away just like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good thing I didn't lose anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon did! Paimon's secret stash. Waaah... If Paimon ever runs into that Weasel Thief again, Paimon's gonna make it pay back double!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? We can get in through here? Paimon thought a place full of secrets would be more heavily guarded than this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! This is way down under the ground!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tch... Paimon knew it'd be sealed shut!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now Paimon's even more curious... What kind of facility is this? If only we could get inside and take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Traps!? But how come there's no alarm going off?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't tell Paimon the staff have to figure their way through all this, too? That's downright cruel...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We have to go even deeper? How does anyone put up with working in a place with no sunlight?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe that's the point. If they never see the sun, they won't know when it's time to clock out! How horrible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, that's all three sets of data! Let's head back to the underground lab!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's input the data!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this? It looks like something to record data with...
